scope: Display subset of 600 retained final answers: 20 tasks x 10 repeats x 3 displayed arms (baseline_allowed, baseline, rust), with no within-arm filtering. The original four-arm execution and its 800 final answers remain fully preserved in the source archive; this is a report projection, not a new three-arm experiment. Physical-attempt accounting below covers only the displayed arms.
quality_field_definition: GLM5.2 judge score using the frozen reference; not independent human quality assessment.
aggregation: Equal task weights; percent change is ratio of group means, not mean per-trial percentage.

interval_definition.interpretation: Sensitivity to composition of these 20 tasks; no separate within-task resampling or noninferiority margin.

no_subagent.allowed_control_policy: Original OpenCode permissions; delegation permitted, not forced

experiment.execution_order: Original execution rotated all four arms within each task and repetition; each arm started 50 of 200 formal blocks. This report displays three of those arms without changing the executed schedule.
experiment.aggregation_policy: All trials in the displayed arms without trimming or task exclusion; equal-weight task means; paired task bootstrap. Original per-contrast estimates and intervals are unchanged.
experiment.analysis_policy: All completed scheduled trials and all failed attempts for the displayed arms; no within-arm quality or resource trimming. The full original execution archive is retained.
experiment.historical_comparison: Descriptive only: historical rounds ran on different dates

subagent_availability.estimand: disabling optional delegation; all assigned trials

runner_wall_accounting.scope: Runner wall seconds per logical arm/repetition slot for the displayed arms only; includes setup and retries.
runner_wall_accounting.concurrency_note: Sums across concurrent task jobs do not equal workflow elapsed time.

original_common_task_comparison.scope: All mean fields for the three displayed arms, compared on the 17 common tasks.

limitations: No contemporaneous ZG-plus-delegation-allowed arm; no full interaction estimate.
Historical runs are descriptive only; dates differ.
Agent execution time excludes setup and retries; input includes cache and is not a monetary bill.
Four pre-agent installation failures in the displayed baseline_allowed arm have missing usage; preserve unknown values instead of zero.
archived_analysis_scope: SHA-256 of the unchanged full original execution analysis, before this display projection; source_reports below likewise retain the original full report hashes.
